note: Record of how each per-stage setting is applied in dp-cre-modernization. Fabric does not read this file. Deployment rules are created in the deployment pipeline's interface, by the item's owner, after the item's first deployment to that stage; here they are fallbacks for when automatic rebinding doesn't happen. Variable library values are set in vl_cre_settings value sets. Stage values are labels; Fabric shows Lakehouses by name or asks for IDs. See docs/deployment.md.
